dependency_sharing.blocks: global pair resampling automatically selects the pair's frozen block
dependency_sharing.pair_members: selected together by global pair draw; source-group draws are independent between members
dependency_sharing.selected_model_seeds: source-group draws are shared across all selected seed occurrences

draw_order: draw the full replicate-by-8 model-seed index array
draw the full replicate-by-40 global-pair index array
draw the full replicate-by-40-by-2-by-34 source-group index array

estimand.effect_unit: one model seed by one target semantic pattern
estimand.formula: tau_pp = 100/(8*80) * sum_seed sum_pattern [accuracy(exposed arm, frozen 200 rows) - accuracy(unexposed arm, same frozen 200 rows)]
estimand.pair_weighting: equal across all 40 frozen global pairs and both members
estimand.row_weighting: equal across the 200 frozen evaluation rows within target

exposure_alignment.algorithm: Within each block, model seed, and pair member, use the arm whose frozen materialization assignment exposes that member; use the complementary arm as unexposed.

secondary_analyses.block_effects: Point estimates for each frozen block; descriptive only.

calibration.aggregation: Align exposed and unexposed logits within block and target, concatenate both blocks within seed, compute metrics over 16000 rows, subtract, then average seed differences.
calibration.binning: 15 equal-width confidence bins on [0,1], with 1 included in the final bin
